policies.title: Mozambican ordinary passports: Angola reciprocal visa waiver
policies.summary: Angola's current official treaty registry records its reciprocal visa-exemption agreement with Mozambique as covering ordinary passports.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Mozambican passport holder making a short visit to Angola under the bilateral agreement recorded for ordinary passports.
The registry records 17 November 2017 for the ordinary-passport agreement; passport validity, border formalities and final admission remain separate.
Work, residence, study, special documents and other non-visitor purposes remain outside scope.

policies.title: Mozambican ordinary passports: Grenada visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Grenada's actively linked April 2024 Embassy schedule lists Mozambique as requiring no visitor visa.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Mozambican passport holder travelling to Grenada as a short visitor.
The Embassy's live visitor page confirms requirements depend on citizenship; work, study, residence, special documents and other purposes remain outside scope.
The linked schedule was updated April 2024; carrier checks, entry conditions and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Mozambican ordinary passports: Panama authorized visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule names Mozambique in the authorized-visa cohort, requiring advance consular approval unless a separate third-country-document waiver applies.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Mozambican passport holder who does not qualify for Panama's separate valid third-country visa or residence waiver.
The authorized visa must be processed by the competent Panamanian consulate before travel; the Embassy says approval may take up to 60 business days.
Work, residence, transit, special documents, consular jurisdiction and final admission remain outside scope.

application.label: Panama Embassy authorized-visa instructions
application.processingTime: Up to 60 business days, depending on document verification and completion.
steps: Determine that Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver does not apply.
Submit the listed authorized-visa documents to the competent Panamanian consulate before travel.
Do not finalize travel arrangements until the visa has been granted.
